title: ConvertResponse v1
description: The converted text and how it was made. Sent by the engine to the keyboard, and written by arabizi-cli as one JSON object per line. Swift: ArabiziContracts.ConvertResponse. Explained in docs/API_CONTRACTS.md.

v.description: Contract version; anything else is rejected.

id.description: The id of the request this answers.

text.description: The text to insert: Arabic script, with protected spans (links, numbers, emoji) unchanged.

outcome.description: Which path produced the text: the model, the rule fallback with its reason, or unchanged.

latencyMs.description: Time from receiving the request to answering it.
